description: Edit a file. Two mutually exclusive edit shapes: {oldText,newText} literal replacement, or line edits (1-based). {startLine,endLine,newText} replaces the inclusive range; newText "" deletes, no trailing newline. Omitting endLine INSERTS before startLine instead of replacing, and startLine = lines+1 appends at EOF. Line edits require rev and are applied bottom-up in one atomic pass, so numbers from a single grep/read stay valid; a stale rev is rejected, never applied. Returns the new rev. dryRun shows the diff. In a zone with policy overwrite="rev" every edit needs rev, including {oldText}; in overwrite="never" zones editing is refused outright. To replace a whole file use write_file. Document formats are read-only.
